failure.cause: 51 sample columns written as a bare '.' (whole-column missing), which the validator's diploid check rejects
failure.note: the validator behaved fail-closed and correctly refused to certify the callset; its message names ploidy rather than whole-column missingness, which is a reporting improvement tracked separately and does not affect this decision

downstream_resource.note: resource direction was favourable; it does not enter the verdict because the data contract failed first

representation_change_expected_from_rebl.includes: phasing collapse (phased to unphased, same alleles) and no-call written as whole-column missing
representation_change_expected_from_rebl.assessment: these alter how an identical call is written, not which call was made

scientific_semantic_difference.assessment: these change which calls exist and what the cohort accounting says, regardless of cause

decision_scope: The storage-saving trade-off is incompatible with this repository's current exact scientific/data-contract requirement. This is not a finding that ReblockGVCFs is incorrect: discarding reference-confidence resolution to shrink gVCFs is precisely what the tool is designed to do, and the 86.6 million hom-ref calls that became no-calls are that design working as documented under GQ bands 20/100. The repository's contract currently requires the joint callset to preserve called genotypes, non-reference calls, the variant set and cohort accounting exactly, and that contract and this trade-off cannot both hold.
revisit_if: storage becomes the primary blocker and a different contract is defined that explicitly accepts a bounded callset difference, with the accepted bounds stated in advance and verified against a truth set or an agreed tolerance
not_the_reason: size reduction and resource improvements were real and are recorded above; they did not enter the verdict

scope.truth_set: none available; no accuracy claim is made for either side
scope.explicitly_not_claimed: no claim that reblocking is less accurate, only that it is not callset-preserving under this contract
